senses.gloss: 1. उप-हित mfn. (for 2. See s.v.) put on or upon, placed, deposited, put into, KātyŚr.; MBh.; Hariv.; Ragh. &c.
joining, connected with
mixed, ŚBr.; Mālav.; Suśr.
(in Gr.) immediately preceded by, RPrāt.
resting or depending upon, having as a condition, Vedāntas.; Sarvad.
used, employed for, MBh.; Ragh.
brought near, handed over, given, MBh.; R.; Mṛcch. &c.
misled, deceived, MBh.
2. उप-हित mfn. (for 1. See p. 199, col. 3) good in a secondary degree, somewhat good
उप-हित n. a secondary good, MBh. xii, 5219.
उपा॑-हित mfn. put or placed on, deposited
set out, proposed (as a prize), ŚBr. xi
caused, effected, produced, Bhartṛ.; Gīt.
joined, annexed, L.
agreed upon, made or done mutually, L.
उपा॑-हित m. outbreak of fire, fire, Gaut. xvi, 34.
(also) m. a meteor, L.
उपा॑-हित See उपा-√ धा, p. 213.
उ॑प-हिति f. the putting or placing upon, Nyāyam.
devotedness to, TS. ii.
उप-हदन n. the act of discharging excrement upon, VarBṛS.
उपा-√ हन् Ā. (p. -घ्नान॑) to beat upon, ŚBr. ii.
उ॑प-हत mfn. hit, hurt, damaged, injured, visited, afflicted, pained, infected, ŚBr.; MBh.; R.; Śak. &c.
affected, transported (with passion), BhP.
seduced, misled, Śāntiś.
distressed, weakened, discouraged, MBh.; R.; Hit.; Kathās.
killed, Uttarar.
scattered over, covered Comm. on Mn. iii, 208.
उ॑प-हत—धी mfn. affected in mind, infatuated.
उपहतात्मन् mfn. id., Kathās.; Car.
उपहतक mfn. ill-fated, unfortunate, unlucky, L.
उप-हति f. hurt, damage, injure, oppression, Kap.; Naiṣ.
(= अव-कर) a dust-heap, Sāy. on TāṇḍyaBr. i, 6, 5.
उप-हत्नु॑ mfn. hitting, hurting, destroying (enemies), RV. ii, 33, 11 = AV. xviii, 4, 40.
उप-हत्या॑ f. hurt, damage, morbid affection (as of the eyes), AV. v, 4, 10.
उप-हन्तव्य mfn. to be killed, Kathās.
उप-हन्तृ mfn. one who hurts or destroys, a destroyer, Sāy. on RV. ii, 33, 11
pernicious, unwholesome, Suśr.
उप-ह॑व्य See उप-√ हु.
उप-ह॑व्य m. a secondary or supplementary libation or sacrifice, N. of a particular religious act, AV. xi, 7, 15; KātyŚr. xxii, 8; ĀśvŚr. &c.
उप-हसित mfn. laughed at, derided, Kathās.
उप-हसित n. laughter accompanied by shaking the head (स-शिरः-कम्पम्), Daśar. iv, 70.
उप-ह॑स्वन् mfn. laughing at, deriding, mocking, RV. viii, 45, 23.
उप-हास॑ (अस्), m. laughter, derision, mockery, jeer, Kathās.; Ragh.; Sāh.
ridiculousness, VarBṛS.
fun, play, jest, sport, ŚBr.; PārGṛ.; MBh. &c.
उप-हास—गिर् f. a joke, jest, L.
उप-हासनीयता f. ridiculousness, Mṛcch.
उपहासास्पद n. a laughing-stock.
उप-हासक mfn. ridiculing others, jocose, L.
उप-हासक m. a jester, L.
उप-हासक n. drollery, fun, BhP. x, 18, 15.
उप-हासिन् mfn. ifc. deriding, ridiculing, Sāh.; Veṇīs.
उप-हास्य mfn. to be laughed at or derided, ridiculous, Mṛcch.; Kathās.
उप-हास्य—ता f. the state of being to be laughed at or derided, ridiculousness
(उपहास्यतां-√ गम्, to expose one's self to laughter, become ridiculous, Ragh. i, 3.)
उप-हस्त m. the act of taking with the hand, receiving [T.] g. वेतनादि, Pāṇ. iv, 4, 12, (not in Kāś.)
उपहस्तय Nom. P. उपहस्तयति, to take with the hand, receive, T.
उपहस्तिका f. a box for betel or condiments, Daś.
1. उप-√ 2. हा Ā. (Pot. 2. sg. -जिहीथास्) to descend, come down upon, Śiś. i, 37.
2. उप-√ 3. हा Pass. -हीयते, to diminish, wane, MBh. xiii, 2028.
उप-हालक m. pl. N. of a people (= कुन्तल), L.
उप-√ हिंस् P. Ā. -हिंसति, -ते, to hurt, wound, injure, damage, MBh.; R.; Mn.
उप-√ हु P. -जुहोति, to sacrifice or offer a libation in addition to, KātyŚr.; ŚāṅkhŚr.; Bhag.
उप-हरण n. the act of bringing near, proffering, offering, BhP.
presenting victims
distributing or serving out food
taking, seizing, L.
उप-हरणीय mfn. to be offered or presented, Mālatīm.; Kathās.
उप-हर्तव्य mfn. id.
उप-हर्तृ mfn. one who offers or presents, one who serves out (food), a host, Mn. v, 51.
उप-हार m. offering, oblation (to a deity)
complimentary gift, present (to a king or superior), MBh.; Megh.; Kathās. &c.
(उपहारं वि-√ धा, to offer an oblation to a god [acc.], sacrifice to any one, Kathās.)
a particular kind of alliance (purchased through a gift), Kām.; Hit. &c.
food (distributed to guests &c.)
(with the Pāśupatas) a kind of religious service (consisting of laughter, song, dance, muttering हुडुक्, adoration and pious ejaculation), Sarvad. 77, 22.
उप-हार—ता f.
उप-हार—त्व n. the state of being an oblation or offering, Kum.; Kathās.
उप-हार—पशु m. a victim, Kathās.
उप-हार—वर्मन् m. N. of a man, Daś.
उपहारक mf(इका). an offering, oblation, gift, present, BhP.; Kathās.
उप-हारिन् mfn. offering, presenting
sacrificing.
उप-हारी-√ कृ P. Ā. to offer (as an oblation or sacrifice), Kathās.; Hit.
उपहारी-चिकीर्षु mfn. intending to sacrifice any one, Kathās.
उप-हार्य mfn. to be offered as an oblation
to be presented, BhP.
उप-हार्य n. an offering, oblation, MBh.; BhP.
उप-हृत mfn. brought near, offered, presented
immolated, sacrificed (as a victim)
served out (as food)
taken
collected, gathered.
उपा॑-हृत mfn. brought, offered, given, VarBṛS.; BhP. &c.
prepared, undertaken, AV. x, 1, 19.
उप-हृत्य ind.p. having brought near &c.
उप-होम॑ अस्, m. an additional or supplementary sacrifice, ŚBr. xi.
उप-√ ह्वृ Ā. -ह्व॑रते, to approach by windings and turnings, reach an end after many deviations or errors, RV. i, 141, 1.
उप-ह्वर॑ अस्, m. a winding or circuitous course full of turnings, uneven or rough ground, slope, declivity &c., RV. i, 62, 6; 87, 2; viii, 6, 28
a car, carriage, L.
उप-ह्वर॑ अम्, n. (generally ए loc.) proximity, nearness, RV. viii, 69, 6; MBh.
a solitary or private place, RV. viii, 96, 14; MBh.
उप-ह्वर्तव्य mfn. to be approached by windings and turnings, Sāy.

उपा-√ ह्वे Ā. -ह्वयते, to call near, invite, summon;
to challenge, Kauś.; MBh.; Bhaṭṭ.

उप-हव॑ अस्, m. calling to, inviting, invitation, (उप-हव॑म्-√ इष्, to desire an invitation to [loc.], wish to be invited to, e.g. त॑स्मिन्न् इ॑न्द्र उपहव॑म् ऐच्छत, Indra wished to be invited to that [sacrifice] TS. ii, 4, 12, 1), TS.; ŚBr.; ĀśvŚr.; KātyŚr.
उ॑प-हूत mfn. called near, invited, AV.; TBr.; ŚāṅkhŚr.; MBh. &c.
that to which one invites, TS. i; ŚBr. i; KātyŚr. iii
summoned, invoked, AV. vii, 60, 4; 5; VS. xx, 35
उ॑प-हूत (अस्), m. N. of Śākalya, Kāś. on Pāṇ. vi, 2, 146
उ॑प-हूत (आस्), m. pl. N. of particular manes, L.
उप-हूति f. calling (to fight), challenging, challenge, Śiś.
उप-हूय ind.p. having called near or invited &c.
उप-ह्वान n. the act of inviting, invitation, KātyŚr.
उपा-√ हिण्ड् to wander, ib.
